description:
Build a peer group for an FDIC-insured institution and rank it against peers on financial and efficiency metrics at a single report date.

Three usage modes:
  - Subject-driven: provide cert and repdte — auto-derives peer criteria from the subject's asset size and charter class
  - Explicit criteria: provide repdte plus asset_min/asset_max, charter_classes, state, or raw_filter
  - Subject with overrides: provide cert plus explicit criteria to override auto-derived defaults

Metrics ranked (fixed order):
  - Total Assets, Total Deposits, ROA, ROE, Net Interest Margin
  - Equity Capital Ratio, Efficiency Ratio, Loan-to-Deposit Ratio
  - Deposits-to-Assets Ratio, Non-Interest Income Share

Rankings use competition rank (1, 2, 2, 4). Rank, denominator, and percentile all use the same comparison set: matched peers plus the subject institution.

Output includes:
  - Subject rankings and percentiles (when cert provided)
  - Peer group medians
  - Peer list with CERTs (pass to fdic_compare_bank_snapshots for trend analysis)
  - Metric definitions with directionality metadata

Override precedence: cert derives defaults, then explicit params override them.

active_only.description: Limit to institutions where ACTIVE:1 (currently operating, FDIC-insured).

asset_max.description: Maximum total assets ($thousands) for peer selection. Defaults to 200% of subject's report-date assets when cert is provided.

asset_min.description: Minimum total assets ($thousands) for peer selection. Defaults to 50% of subject's report-date assets when cert is provided.

cert.description: Subject institution CERT number. When provided, auto-derives peer criteria and ranks this bank against peers.

charter_classes.description: Charter class codes to include (e.g., ["N", "SM"]). Defaults to the subject's charter class when cert is provided.

extra_fields.description: Additional FDIC field names to include as raw values in the response. Does not affect peer selection.

limit.description: Max peer records returned in the response. All matched peers are used for ranking regardless of this limit.

raw_filter.description: Advanced: raw ElasticSearch query string appended to peer selection criteria with AND.

repdte.description: Report Date (REPDTE) in YYYYMMDD format. FDIC data is published quarterly on: March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31. Example: 20231231 for Q4 2023. If omitted, defaults to the most recent quarter-end date likely to have published data (~90-day lag).

name: fdic_peer_group_analysis
